From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>

Subject: Consolidating developer productivity SaaS renewals — proposal & gaps

Team —

I've pulled the inventory for our core developer productivity tools and there are three materially overlapping renewal windows that we should consolidate (or at least coordinate) to avoid last-minute premiums and to make multi-year discount conversations possible: 

- GitHub Enterprise (org license) — expires 2026-11-30 (approx 12k seats)
- JetBrains All Products Pack (corporate) — expires 2026-12-15 (120 seats)
- Atlassian Cloud (Jira/Confluence/Bitbucket) — expires 2026-10-31 (projects across eng + product)

Attached: renewal_inventory.xlsx (summary by team + billing owner).

My proposal:
- Consolidate procurement outreach this week with a single RFP (SaaS_RFP_v2.docx) to request unified discounting and aligned invoicing windows.
- Ask vendors for 3/2/1 year pricing and EOL/feature roadmap notes so we can evaluate risk of multi-year commits.
- Target: negotiate a single consolidated plan or aligned windows by end of Oct so renewals due in Nov/Dec are covered.

Questions for procurement/finance/legal:
- karthik — can procurement run a consolidated RFP and own vendor negotiations?
- vivek — are we comfortable with multi-year commits for any of the line items (need finance sign-off)?
- laura — any legal concerns with monthly -> annual invoicing changes?

If no objections I'll draft the RFP and send to the three vendors for pricing by 10/6.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Product Operations Manager
